basic_profile.bio: Born and raised in New Jersey, I'm a 35-year-old software developer with a passion for anime and a knack for discussing the nuances of storytelling. I work remotely, which allows me to indulge in my hobbies without the constraints of a 9-to-5 job. When I'm not coding or watching anime, I enjoy card collecting and occasionally participate in local NJ swinger events. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my evenings online, primarily between 7 PM and midnight EST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and a lifelong interest in Japanese culture, I've honed my expertise in anime through years of dedicated viewing and participation in anime communities. My understanding is further enhanced by my work in tech, which keeps me updated on the latest in animation technology and storytelling techniques.
